_comment: Human/Grok knowledge the FPL API does not encode: injuries it hasn't flagged, rotation risk (e.g. players back late from deep World Cup runs), or 'nailed' starters. Match by player web_name (as shown on the FPL site). start_prob overrides the model's minutes-based estimate: 0 = won't play, 0.5 = 50/50 / rotation risk, 1 = nailed. Grok populates/refreshes this automatically when the xAI key has credits; you can also edit it by hand.
